profile.headline: SDE at Amazon
profile.summary: A graduate from Boston College with a strong interest in working with cloud database platforms, data analytics software, mobile app development and IoT systems.

positions.title: Software Developer
positions.description:
• Designed and developed a mobile application that can connect and receive data from multiple Bluetooth Low Energy sensors to analyze and create 3-D visual representations.
• Created and maintained a relational database through Amazon Web Services to store and analyze patient data. 
• Collaborated with computer engineers and firmware developers to improve the stability and accuracy of the BLE sensors.
• Utilized Amazon Web Services to manage and host the company's website.

positions.title: Data Entry Clerk
positions.description:
• Utilized signature checking and validation system to check and process  submissions for local state initiatives.
• Assisted in managing and organizing multiple detail oriented tasks.

projects.title: DaBLEX
projects.description: Solution allowing for multiple, simultaneous bluetooth low energy connection and consistent data streaming between BLE supported devices and Android devices with Android 4.4+. Created using Google's sample project BluetoothLeGatt as a template.

projects.title: Moneo App
projects.description: A simple mobile app that provides users with quick and convenient access to upcoming and trending international films and trailers. Powered by moviedb.org, users are able to view a film's release date, average vote, description and trailer. Other functionalities include but are not limited to storing of user's favorite films and locating the nearest theater through Google Maps.

organizations.name: Sustainable Living and Learning Community
organizations.description:
• Participated in weekly student discussions about sustainability, environmental awareness, and service
• Discussed topics including integral ecology, virtual water, and climate change
